figs.name: nuclear-level-measurement-working-principle-diagram
figs.alt: nuclear level measurement with shielded gamma source and detector strip outside the vessel
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing gamma rays from a shielded source crossing the vessel: liquid absorbs part of them, so the detector strip sees less radiation as level rises.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Nuclear level measurement with gamma source, vessel and detector outside the vessel</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How Nuclear Level Measurement Works</text>
<rect x="290" y="290" width="220" height="190" fill="#bfdbfe"/>
<rect x="290" y="80" width="220" height="400" rx="20" fill="none" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="8"/>
<text x="400" y="390" font-size="18" fill="#1e3a8a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Process</text>
<line x1="298" y1="290" x2="502" y2="290" stroke="#1e40af" stroke-width="3"/>
<rect x="120" y="230" width="110" height="120" rx="10" fill="#475569"/>
<circle cx="210" cy="290" r="10" fill="#eab308"/>
<text x="175" y="380" font-size="17" fill="#334155" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Source in</text>
<text x="175" y="402" font-size="17" fill="#334155" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">shielded housing</text>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="110" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="150" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="190" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="230" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="270" stroke="#eab308" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="310" stroke="#fde68a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="350" stroke="#fde68a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="390" stroke="#fde68a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="430" stroke="#fde68a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 5"/>
<line x1="220" y1="290" x2="600" y2="470" stroke="#fde68a" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="5 5"/>
<rect x="600" y="100" width="40" height="380" rx="8" fill="#65a30d" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="660" y="260" font-size="18" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Detector</text>
<text x="660" y="284" font-size="18" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">strip</text>
<rect x="656" y="360" width="130" height="54" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="721.0" y="381.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">4 to 20 mA</text>
<text x="721.0" y="404.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">level signal</text>
<text x="110" y="130" font-size="17" fill="#a16207" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Above the liquid:</text>
<text x="110" y="154" font-size="17" fill="#a16207" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">rays pass</text>
<text x="400" y="520" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Higher level absorbs more gamma, so less reaches the detector</text>
<text x="400" y="546" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Source and detector are both outside the vessel, nothing touches the process</text>
</svg>

figs.name: nuclear-level-measurement-selection-flowchart
figs.alt: flowchart for when to choose nuclear level measurement over conventional level sensors
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog turning the article checklist into a decision path: harsh conditions, no penetration or unsafe access, plus manageable licensing, point to nuclear level.
figs.after_h2: When Should You Choose Nuclear Level Measurement?
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 580" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flowchart for deciding when to choose nuclear level measurement</title>
<rect width="800" height="580" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">When to Choose Nuclear Level Measurement</text>
<polygon points="300,62.0 470.0,110 300,158.0 130.0,110" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#65a30d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="300" y="105.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Do process conditions</text>
<text x="300" y="126.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">destroy normal sensors?</text>
<line x1="470" y1="110" x2="500" y2="110" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="485" y="98" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<line x1="300" y1="158" x2="300" y2="192" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="320" y="182" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="300,192.0 470.0,240 300,288.0 130.0,240" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#65a30d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="300" y="235.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Is vessel penetration</text>
<text x="300" y="256.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">not allowed?</text>
<line x1="470" y1="240" x2="500" y2="240" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="485" y="228" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<line x1="300" y1="288" x2="300" y2="322" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="320" y="312" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<polygon points="300,322.0 470.0,370 300,418.0 130.0,370" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#65a30d" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="300" y="365.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Is maintenance access</text>
<text x="300" y="386.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">difficult or unsafe?</text>
<line x1="470" y1="370" x2="500" y2="370" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="485" y="358" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Yes</text>
<polyline points="500,110 500,370" fill="none" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="300" y1="418" x2="300" y2="450" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="320" y="440" font-size="17" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">No</text>
<rect x="150" y="450" width="300" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="300.0" y="479.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Use radar, ultrasonic,</text>
<text x="300.0" y="502.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">DP or displacer first</text>
<polygon points="650,190.0 780.0,250 650,310.0 520.0,250" fill="#f7fee7" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="650" y="234.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Licensing and</text>
<text x="650" y="255.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">approvals</text>
<text x="650" y="276.95" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">manageable?</text>
<line x1="500" y1="250" x2="518" y2="250" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<line x1="650" y1="310" x2="650" y2="380" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="670" y="348" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="540" y="380" width="220" height="80" rx="10" fill="#65a30d" stroke="#365314" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="650.0" y="414.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Nuclear level</text>
<text x="650.0" y="439.15" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">measurement</text>
<text x="400" y="556" font-size="17" fill="#365314" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Not the first choice, but often the best final choice</text>
</svg>
